ValidationRule.description: Enforces Type__c/RecordType pairing on every DML path, since RecordType picklist restriction is UI-only. OtherFeesGrid must use Courtage Assurance et Capi or Performance Fees; every other record type must use SINGLE RULE or MULTI RULE.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Type must match the grid's Record Type: Other Fees Grids require Courtage Assurance et Capi or Performance Fees; every other grid requires SINGLE RULE or MULTI RULE.
